title: When Planning Problems Become Hard for LLMs: Separating Structural Complexity from Semantic Interpretability
abstract: arXiv:2610.26964v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) struggle with classical planning, but benchmarks rarely distinguish structural difficulty from the difficulty of interpreting symbolic vocabulary. We examine seven STRIPS domains with BFS-optimal plan lengths. For predicting structural difficulty without solving an instance, the zero-training delete-relaxation heuristic $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ outperforms learned alternatives on held-out domains (mean Spearman $|\rho|=0.931$), including ridge regression ($0.707$), object count ($0.657$), and the episodic retrieval architecture ARC ($0.400$). ARC also fails to outperform a linear model using the same features. To isolate semantic effects, we progressively rename predicates while preserving states, transitions, and optimal plans. translated_title: 当规划问题对大语言模型变得困难时：区分结构复杂性与语义可解释性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在经典规划任务上表现不佳，但现有基准很少将结构难度与解释符号词汇的难度区分开来。我们研究了七个具有BFS最优规划长度的STRIPS域。对于在不求解具体实例的情况下预测结构难度，零训练的删除松弛启发式 $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ 在留出域上优于各种学习方法（平均Spearman $|\rho|=0.931$），包括岭回归（0.707）、对象数量（0.657）以及情景检索架构ARC（0.400）。ARC在使用相同特征时也无法超越线性模型。为了分离语义影响，我们在保持状态、转移和最优规划不变的前提下逐步重命名谓词。随着重命名比例从0%增加到100%，LLM的有效规划成功率从67.5%下降到40.0%，而拒绝回答率始终保持在0%。
tldr: 本研究通过零训练的删除松弛启发式 $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ 有效预测规划问题的结构难度，并发现当谓词被重命名而问题结构不变时LLM规划成功率显著下降，证明LLM在规划上的困难部分源于语义可解释性而非纯粹的结构复杂性。
en_tdlr: This study shows that the zero-training delete-relaxation heuristic $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ best predicts the structural difficulty of planning problems, and that LLM planning success drops significantly when predicates are renamed while problem structure is preserved, demonstrating that LLM planning failures stem partly from semantic interpretability rather than structural complexity alone.
